input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue-generating software products; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 7) photo-editing: Sony's in-file lens corrections (ARW 0x7032, 0x7035, 0x7037) against lensfun

deviations.did: Re-routed with --task from the routine prompt (ventures/1), as prompt.md's 'If the message that started the session names a specific task' allows.
